# Test Fixtures / 测试夹具

Use synthetic records only. `synthetic_policy_16.csv` is a deterministic 16-row policy fixture covering O1–O4, overlapping rules, boundaries, MRR 2,000 and 10,000, tenure 12, and score 0.30. Fixtures must not resemble or expose actual course/customer records.

仅使用合成记录。`synthetic_policy_16.csv` 是固定的 16 行政策夹具，覆盖 O1–O4、规则重叠、边界值、MRR 2,000 和 10,000、Tenure 12 及分数 0.30。夹具不得包含或暴露真实课程/客户记录。
